questions.question: How did Ui Ui survive Smallpox Deity's attack?
questions.subject: Ui Ui/Synopsis

answer.item: Ui Ui used simple domain to block the effects of Smallpox Deity's ability.

questions.question: Where did Ui Ui and Mei Mei end up after the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Ui Ui/Synopsis

answer.item: Ui Ui and Mei Mei are seen in a hotel room in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, having escaped "Pseudo-Geto" off-panel using Ui Ui's cursed technique.

questions.question: What role did Ui Ui play in the Culling Game?
questions.subject: Ui Ui/Synopsis

answer.item: During the Culling Game, Ui Ui became affiliated with the group of sorcerers, and was used as the means of communication by group members.

questions.question: What can Ui Ui's Spatial Transference do?
questions.subject: Ui Ui/Synopsis

answer.item: Ui Ui explains that his innate technique Spatial Transference can switch the souls of the targets he has marked with their permission

questions.question: How did Gojo's body get back to headquarters after the fight?
questions.subject: Ui Ui/Synopsis

answer.item: Ui Ui uses Spatial Transference to teleport his body back to HQ

questions.question: Who does Ui Ui meet on January 14, 2087?
questions.subject: Ui Ui/Synopsis

answer.item: Ui Ui meets the Deskunte warrior Dabura Karaba
